label: academic-research-skills

codex plugin marketplace add Imbad0202/academic-research-skills-codex --ref main && codex plugin add ars-codex@ars-codex

claude plugin marketplace add ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp && claude plugin install chrome-devtools-mcp@chrome-devtools-plugins --scope user

label: claude-md-management
description: audits CLAUDE.md quality, captures session learnings back into it — on-theme for this repo since .ai/skills/core/*.md is this project's own CLAUDE.md source

label: codebase-memory-mcp
description: installs its own MCP server + Claude Code hooks — see https://github.com/DeusData/codebase-memory-mcp

installs.shell: claude plugin marketplace add openai/codex-plugin-cc && claude plugin install codex@openai-codex --scope user

label: composio
description: one MCP endpoint proxying 20,000+ tools across 1000+ SaaS apps (GitHub, Slack, Notion, etc.), loaded just-in-time so the catalog doesn't blow context — https://composio.dev. No static public URL: needs a Composio account + API key, and the MCP session URL is generated per-user via their SDK first (see https://composio.dev/toolkits/composio/framework/claude-code). Export COMPOSIO_MCP_URL and COMPOSIO_API_KEY before running this. Codex CLI skipped — Composio auths via a custom X-API-Key header, not the bearer token codex's --url flow expects

label: context7
description: docs MCP server — Claude gets the official marketplace plugin, Codex gets a direct mcp add, ctx7 setup covers Cursor/opencode/VS Code/30+ other clients

label: github-mcp-server
description: official GitHub MCP server (github/github-mcp-server), remote-hosted at api.githubcopilot.com — first use needs OAuth or a GitHub PAT. This is the machine-wide Claude plugin install; this project's own .ai/mcp-servers.json 'github' entry points at the same official remote server for whoever clones this repo

installs.shell: codex mcp add github --url https://api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/ --bearer-token-env-var GITHUB_PAT_TOKEN

label: hookify
description: define Claude Code hooks from plain markdown rules instead of hand-writing shell/JS hook scripts
